n4382a9b000.headline: TIPS highlights positive second-quarter trade, investment movements
n4382a9b000.summary: TIPS' Real Economy Bulletin found GDP rose 0.4% year-on-year in the second quarter, against population growth of 1.3%. Nearly all of this year's GDP growth came from professional services.
n4382a9b000.why: GDP growth per capita indicates whether an economy is improving living standards, and sector concentration affects the outlook for investment and employment.

n0e3b2af268.headline: Why is the exchange rate GH¢17 to $1? Mahama fires 5 questions to Bawumia
n0e3b2af268.summary: Former President John Mahama, the NDC presidential candidate, asked Vice President Bawumia why the dollar exchanges for 17 cedis. The exchange rate has become a campaign issue ahead of Ghana's election.
n0e3b2af268.why: The cedi's value against the dollar affects import costs, inflation and the cost of Ghana's dollar-denominated debt.

n78280aa4cc.headline: Canadians wary of adopting digital dollar, Bank of Canada finds
n78280aa4cc.summary: A Bank of Canada study found Canadians prefer cash and card payments and raised privacy and security concerns about a possible digital dollar. The findings inform the central bank's design work.
n78280aa4cc.why: A central bank digital currency would change how payments and bank deposits function, making its design a concern for banks and the financial system.

n2b2ac63486.headline: S&P 500 closes lower on Wednesday as investors brace for more Big Tech earnings: Live updates
n2b2ac63486.summary: US stocks slipped on Wednesday as traders digested a wave of earnings and looked ahead to further results from major technology companies.
n2b2ac63486.why: The S&P 500 tracks about 500 large US companies and is the main gauge of US equity market performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The benchmark closed lower on Wednesday amid earnings-driven caution.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n2b2ac63486.why_moved: The index slipped as traders digested earnings and awaited more reports from large technology companies.

n895dbb6d93.headline: ‘Rapid growth’ on the cards for local contact centre market
n895dbb6d93.summary: BPESA says South Africa's global business services sector is set to see rapid growth despite a tough global economy.
n895dbb6d93.why: Global business services and contact centres are an export-oriented outsourcing sector that generates employment and foreign currency earnings.

n993afcb0e4.headline: Balwin expects better second half, with positive sentiment starting to materialise
n993afcb0e4.summary: JSE-listed developer Balwin reported a 28% fall in revenue to R852.7 million and a 57% drop in profit to R76.9 million for the six months to August 31.
n993afcb0e4.why: Balwin is a South African residential property developer listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, so its results reflect local housing demand and credit conditions.

n7e80fdbc07.headline: Africa Re CEO highlights growth in facultative business and market resilience
n7e80fdbc07.summary: Africa Re's chief executive highlighted growth in the facultative reinsurance business and the resilience of the company's markets, with diversified portfolio and economic support aiding performance.
n7e80fdbc07.why: Africa Re is a pan-African reinsurance company, and its results reflect insurance demand and underwriting conditions across African markets.

ne661f5f9f7.headline: Veolia:  a seawater desalination project in Morocco
ne661f5f9f7.summary: Veolia and the Kingdom of Morocco have signed a memorandum of understanding to set up a strategic partnership for the exclusive development of a seawater desalination project.
ne661f5f9f7.why: Veolia is a French utilities and water services group, and desalination contracts are a growing source of long-term infrastructure revenue for such firms.

n91d77c98b9.headline: Rising global production set to keep sugar prices subdued
n91d77c98b9.summary: Rising global sugar production is expected to keep sugar prices subdued.
n91d77c98b9.why: Sugar is a globally traded agricultural commodity, priced mainly through futures on ICE in New York, and its price affects food and beverage makers.

n9301cbcc72.headline: Enablence Technologies Inc. Announces Financial Results for Fiscal Year 2024
n9301cbcc72.summary: Enablence Technologies, an Ottawa-based provider of optical chip technology listed on the TSX Venture Exchange, announced its fiscal 2024 financial results.
n9301cbcc72.why: Enablence makes optical components for telecom and data networks, and its results show the health of a small photonics supplier.

nce448db876.headline: Private schools have means to help special needs pupils hit by VAT – Streeting
nce448db876.summary: Health Secretary Wes Streeting said independent schools should be able to mitigate the effect of VAT on pupils with special educational needs. He said those pupils should not be priced out.
nce448db876.why: VAT on private school fees is a UK tax policy that affects school pricing and the independent education sector.

nf5097b7d21.headline: D.R. Horton sees 2025 revenue, home deliveries below estimates, shares fall
nf5097b7d21.summary: D.R. Horton forecast 2025 revenue and home deliveries below estimates, and its shares fell. The homebuilder cited mortgage rate volatility keeping some buyers on the sidelines.
nf5097b7d21.why: D.R. Horton is one of the largest US homebuilders, so its outlook is a read on US housing demand and mortgage conditions.
nf5097b7d21.why_moved: Forecasts for 2025 revenue and home deliveries came in below estimates. Management pointed to mortgage rate volatility keeping some buyers out of the market.

n9c8b06e869.headline: Circle raises USDC cash-out fees, affecting large-scale redemptions
n9c8b06e869.summary: Circle has raised fees for redeeming its USDC stablecoin for the second time in less than a year, now targeting redemptions above $2 million.
n9c8b06e869.why: Circle issues USDC, one of the largest dollar-pegged stablecoins, and redemption terms affect liquidity in crypto markets.

neb25e8e596.headline: Mortgage approvals jump but housing market on ‘tenterhooks’ ahead of Budget
neb25e8e596.summary: Some 65,600 home loans were approved in the UK last month, 700 more than in August, according to the Bank of England. Housing market activity is described as on tenterhooks ahead of the Budget.
neb25e8e596.why: Mortgage approvals are a leading indicator of UK housing activity, and the Bank of England's data feeds into expectations for interest rates and the broader economy.

nfd12d7e41a.headline: Ghana eyes fuel imports from Dangote oil refinery
nfd12d7e41a.summary: Ghana could buy petroleum products from Nigeria's Dangote Oil Refinery once it runs at full capacity, the head of Ghana's National Petroleum Authority said. This could end monthly fuel imports from Europe worth $400 million.
nfd12d7e41a.why: Dangote Oil Refinery in Lagos is one of Africa's largest single refineries, and its output affects regional fuel trade and import costs across West Africa.

ndb687af649.headline: Thailand Keeps Inflation Target for Next Year With Caveats
ndb687af649.summary: Thai authorities reached a tentative agreement to keep the inflation target at 1% to 3% for next year. The Finance Ministry is pressing the central bank to take steps to spur price growth.
ndb687af649.why: The Bank of Thailand sets monetary policy around its inflation target, which influences interest rates, the baht and borrowing costs.

neab4566ff9.headline: Brazil farmers, government slam Danone for cutting out Brazilian soy
neab4566ff9.summary: Brazilian soybean producers said Danone's decision to stop sourcing soy from Brazil gives good reason for a boycott of its products. The government also criticised the French dairy group.
neab4566ff9.why: Danone is a major French food and dairy company, and its sourcing decisions affect soy demand from key suppliers such as Brazil.

impacts.name: Danone
impacts.why: Its decision to stop buying Brazilian soy could create reputational and supply-chain pressure on the company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n30897097a8.headline: Ebonyi, Katsina, Ekiti post highest growth as IGR hits N2.4trn in 2023
n30897097a8.summary: The 36 states and the FCT generated N2.43 trillion in Internally Generated Revenue in 2023, up 26.03% from N1.93 trillion in 2022, the NBS said.
n30897097a8.why: Internally Generated Revenue measures locally raised public funds, indicating fiscal capacity of Nigerian sub-national governments.

n13aaea9f90.headline: Retail sales of construction and earthmoving equipment falls again - Materials Handling World News
n13aaea9f90.summary: Retail sales of construction and earthmoving equipment fell again in September after an uptick in August, according to Construction Equipment Association figures.
n13aaea9f90.why: Construction equipment sales are an indicator of activity in the building and infrastructure sector.

n67ac246286.headline: Voltas basks in H1 glory as torrid summer of 2024 helps AC biz come up with sizzling show
n67ac246286.summary: Voltas, part of the Tata Group, posted record first-half profits for FY2024, driven by its Unitary Cooling Products business and Electro-Mechanical Projects and Services segment.
n67ac246286.why: Voltas is a major Indian maker of air conditioners and engineering services, and its results reflect demand in cooling and infrastructure projects.

nf49fa25c61.headline: Going In Reverse Is Faster Way Forward for Crescent Bio’s Cancer Immunotherapy
nf49fa25c61.summary: Crescent Biopharma is going public through a reverse merger with GlycoMimetics, which will capitalize the combined company with $200 million. Its lead program is a cancer bispecific antibody.
nf49fa25c61.why: Reverse mergers let private biotech companies list on public markets without a traditional IPO. Cancer immunotherapy is a high-value area where clinical results often drive biotech valuations.

n2858e33b90.headline: Fuel Queues Will Disappear If Marketers Collect From Us — Dangote
n2858e33b90.summary: Aliko Dangote said his refinery holds more than enough fuel in reserve to meet Nigerian demand. He suggested fuel queues would end if marketers collected supplies from the refinery.
n2858e33b90.why: Dangote Refinery is a large privately owned refinery in Lagos that supplies much of Nigeria's petrol, so its output and distribution affect fuel prices and availability.

n0787666a5b.headline: European shares nudge higher before earnings, jobs data
n0787666a5b.summary: European shares rose while Asian stocks were broadly mixed. Markets are awaiting major US tech earnings reports and jobs data.
n0787666a5b.why: European equities track regional growth, earnings and central-bank expectations, and US earnings and jobs data often set the tone for global risk sentiment.

n7b73a5e2d3.headline: UK nuclear plant closures threaten energy bill reductions
n7b73a5e2d3.summary: The scheduled closure of two UK Advanced Gas Reactor nuclear stations is expected to push up wholesale electricity prices in 2027, according to a new report. The report's findings were not further detailed in the input.
n7b73a5e2d3.why: Nuclear generation provides low-carbon baseload power in Britain, and its loss tends to tighten supply and raise wholesale electricity prices.

n7ff6aabf98.headline: Large energy users call on government to support green transition ahead of the Budget
n7ff6aabf98.summary: The UK's largest energy users have called on the government to do more to lower prices and support green infrastructure as part of its pro-growth agenda, ahead of the Budget.
n7ff6aabf98.why: Energy costs affect industrial competitiveness and margins across the UK economy. Policy on energy prices and green investment influences utilities and energy-intensive sectors.

n77cda5fd41.headline: 1.6 million workers will see £102 extra drop into bank accounts
n77cda5fd41.summary: About 1.6 million workers will see £102 extra in their bank accounts, according to a Birmingham Live report. The increase is expected to be announced at the Budget.
n77cda5fd41.why: Changes to pay and tax-free allowances affect household spending power, which feeds into UK consumer demand and inflation.

nd5b221cd72.headline: Gold Price Today: Yellow metal prices up Rs 300/10 gm on Dhanteras, silver opens at Rs 97,850/kg
nd5b221cd72.summary: MCX gold December futures opened 0.4% higher at Rs 78,870, nearing record levels, while silver futures rose 0.43% to Rs 97,850 per kg. Sentiment was supported by easing Middle East tensions.
nd5b221cd72.why: Gold is a widely held store of value and a key benchmark for Indian household and investment demand. MCX is India's main commodity futures exchange.

nde5123d13a.headline: Evening Edition: Israel Strikes Secret Iranian Military Bases
nde5123d13a.summary: The Israeli Air Force carried out focused attacks on secret Iranian military bases tied to nuclear and ballistic missile programs, in response to Iran's largest ballistic missile attack on Israel in early October.
nde5123d13a.why: Escalation between Israel and Iran affects oil supply risk and the broader risk premium across global markets.
nde5123d13a.why_moved: Israel's strikes on Iranian military sites follow Iran's major missile attack, raising Middle East escalation risk.

naec77ee7a1.headline: Iran News: Pezeshkian’s Government Proposes 200% Military Budget Increase Amid Rising Tensions with Israel
naec77ee7a1.summary: Iranian government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani announced on October 29 a proposed 200% increase in Iran's military budget. The move follows rising tensions with Israel.
naec77ee7a1.why: Military spending and regional tensions involving Iran affect oil supply risk, sanctions exposure and the broader Middle East risk premium that investors price in.

n28db6b449d.headline: Canadian Dollar Slides Against Most Majors
n28db6b449d.summary: The Canadian dollar weakened against most major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday. It fell to 1.3901 against the U.S. dollar.
n28db6b449d.why: The Canadian dollar reflects Canada's commodity-linked economy and interest-rate outlook, and it is a key currency for North American trade and portfolios.

impacts.name: Canadian dollar
impacts.why: The currency weakened against most majors and fell to 1.3901 per U.S. dollar in the Asian session.

n59d4171a7c.headline: Saudi 'Davos in the desert' opens with region on war footing
n59d4171a7c.summary: The three-day Saudi forum is expected to draw more than 7,000 delegates, including TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew and chiefs of Citigroup and Goldman Sachs.
n59d4171a7c.why: Investment forums in Saudi Arabia bring global bank and corporate leaders together, and they often signal the kingdom's economic and investment agenda.

ne8395d6582.headline: EU to impose duties on electric vehicle imports from China
ne8395d6582.summary: The European Union is set to impose duties on electric vehicle imports from China. The move is part of a broader trade dispute in which EVs have become a major flashpoint.
ne8395d6582.why: EU tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles shape market access for Chinese automakers and the cost of EVs in Europe.
ne8395d6582.why_moved: The input describes EVs as a flashpoint in a broader trade dispute, which the duties are part of.

nf829e0994f.headline: Goldman Says Traders Are Too Worried About Delays to US Vote Result
nf829e0994f.summary: Goldman Sachs said global investors are overstating the risk that financial markets will be plunged into uncertainty by a lack of a clear winner soon after next week's US presidential election.
nf829e0994f.why: Goldman Sachs is a major US investment bank whose market strategists' views on event risk influence how investors position around elections.

n0444f38d66.headline: China 'bazooka' fizzles, dollar on the march
n0444f38d66.summary: A Reuters morning bid note says China's stimulus 'bazooka' has fizzled while the dollar continues its advance in Asian markets.
n0444f38d66.why: The US dollar's strength and China's policy response shape global capital flows, emerging-market currencies and commodity prices.
n0444f38d66.why_moved: The article says China's stimulus measures have fizzled, while the dollar strengthened.

n66bf4c9ae1.headline: Gemini crypto exchange receives preliminary approval in Singapore
n66bf4c9ae1.summary: Gemini crypto exchange received preliminary approval in Singapore that would allow it to offer digital payment tokens and cross-border money transfer services if fully approved.
n66bf4c9ae1.why: Gemini is a US-based crypto exchange, and licences in major financial centres determine where it can legally offer services.

n5cf4843531.headline: Global airlines association embraces digital currency
n5cf4843531.summary: The International Air Transport Association will offer the option of using digital currencies in its financial settlement systems. The systems now handle 74 currencies.
n5cf4843531.why: IATA is the global trade body for airlines and runs the settlement system that clears airline ticket sales between carriers and agents. Changes to settlement methods can affect payment flows in the aviation industry.

ne07903907b.headline: China's Top Oil Companies Turn in Mixed Results Amid Weak Demand -- Update
ne07903907b.summary: PetroChina reported lower profit and revenue in the third quarter, rounding out mixed results for China's three largest state oil companies. The companies flagged weak demand.
ne07903907b.why: PetroChina is China's largest oil and gas producer and a major state-controlled energy company. Its results reflect domestic fuel demand and the health of China's energy sector.

n504753d9bc.headline: Thousands in Germany strike amid industrial uncertainty, gloom
n504753d9bc.summary: Thousands of German workers began nationwide strikes on Tuesday to press for higher wages, adding to the woes of companies already worried about staying competitive globally.
n504753d9bc.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and wage disputes and strikes can affect industrial output and corporate costs.

n5931a84ab8.headline: Hank Payments Announces Financial Results for Year Ending June 30, 2024
n5931a84ab8.summary: Hank Payments Corp. has announced its financial results for the year ending June 30, 2024. The Toronto-based company is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange.
n5931a84ab8.why: Hank Payments is a small North American payments company, and its results offer a read on profitability in the competitive payments sector.

n31f49fff4e.headline: Infrastructure spending slips to P109 billion in August
n31f49fff4e.summary: Government infrastructure spending fell to P109 billion in August, the first decline in nine months, amid billing delays and adjustments to project timelines.
n31f49fff4e.why: Public infrastructure spending is a key driver of Philippine economic growth, and shifts in its pace affect construction firms, contractors and government fiscal targets.

n850f28839b.headline: Highlights of recent changes to Quebec's international student body
n850f28839b.summary: Quebec wants to reduce the number of international students in the province and has singled out private colleges it says are misusing educational permits.
n850f28839b.why: International student enrolment generates tuition revenue for colleges and universities and affects rental demand in host cities.

n6a8c170b47.headline: Doug Ford government confirms $200 rebate cheques coming to Ontario families. Here’s what you need to know
n6a8c170b47.summary: The Ontario government confirmed a $200 rebate proposal for families in the province, ahead of the fall economic statement. The measure is a provincial fiscal support program.
n6a8c170b47.why: Provincial rebates and fiscal measures affect household spending and provincial budget deficits. Fall economic statements set out the government's fiscal outlook.

ne7dfe10dc6.headline: Bloggers paid 1.2 billion tenge in taxes over 9 months
ne7dfe10dc6.summary: 745 officially registered bloggers in Kazakhstan paid more than 1.2 billion tenge in taxes over nine months, according to the State Revenue Committee.
ne7dfe10dc6.why: The tax contribution from bloggers reflects the growing economic significance of digital content creators in Kazakhstan's economy.
